questions.text: What is the Ideology of Pakistan?
Who was Muhammad bin Qasim and what role did he play in the conquest of Sindh?
What were the Objectives Resolution and when was it adopted?
Explain the role of the All India Muslim League in the demand for separate electorates.
What is the significance of the Tashkent Declaration?

_notes.grading: Values are relevance grades: 2 = the passage answers the question, 1 = same topic but incomplete. Only positive grades count toward recall.
_notes.source_keys: A key is either `<document_id>` or `<document_id>:<page_number>`. Page-level keys are stricter and better, but only sensible for paginated formats like PDF.
_notes.how_these_were_chosen: Each page was picked by running the query and reading the top hits, not by guessing. Re-derive them after any re-chunking, since page numbers are stable but chunk boundaries are not.
_notes.reproducing: `uv run researchos ingest <pdf>` then `uv run researchos evaluate`. Both the document id and the expected pages are recorded here so a re-ingest can be compared against the same yardstick.
